messages:
emma: Following RFC follow-ups: ops and compliance want the PREPARE report to be machine-readable and cryptographically verifiable. We should produce a signed report artifact (sha256 + control-plane signature) that compliance can stash. This avoids ambiguous CSVs.

ravi: Love that. Can we also version the report schema so long-term tooling can parse diffs? e.g., report_v1 with fields: items[], needs_secret(bool), est_bytes, est_time_s.

sophia: Suggest adding a `report_hash` claim embedded in the prewarm token so auditors can prove the token was only used for the exact preflight output. Token minted -> includes report_hash; any later commit must reference same hash.

dan: Operationally, we can make the report include a `delta_only` flag — meaning only keys that changed since last prewarm will be primed. Helps with bandwidth and reduces secret hydations.

emma: Also add an `est_cost_usd` field per item for operator visibility so product can estimate migration costs. Not a billing charge, just estimate.

ravi: For verification: control-plane signs report with rotating keypair. Audit-bot will publish a public verification endpoint and archive signature in WORM storage. Compliance can fetch signature + blob to verify.

sophia: Data-plane contract: priming requests must include either `X-Dry-Token` or `X-Prewarm-Token`, and if `X-Prewarm-Token` includes `report_hash` claim, dataplane should verify token.report_hash == X-Report-Hash header. Reject on mismatch 409 REPORT_MISMATCH.

dan: Edge case: operator runs PREPARE twice (two different reports) and then uses an older token. Must reject token if report_hash does not match latest stored report for that handoff id. We should store immutable reports and require token to reference the specific report id.

emma: Let's add `report_id` and `report_version` to the artifact metadata. Report_id is UUID, report_version increments if PREPARE re-run. Token must carry report_id + report_version.

ravi: Observability: emit event preflight.reported with fields: report_id, report_hash, lease_id, operator, report_version, items_count. Archive full JSON report as artifact link.

sophia: Security: signatures and token link prevents someone from generating a token for an unrelated preflight. Also add a `signed_by` claim with key_id so verifiers know which key to fetch.

dan: UI idea: show a human-friendly summary and a machine view (json schema) side-by-side. Include a one-click "publish verification bundle" that zips report.json + signature + public_key_id link for compliance export.

emma: Compliance ask: add a compliance checksum (HMAC with customer-provided key) optional: if customer wants, we HMAC the report with a key they provide so only they can verify. Useful for enterprise SOCs.

ravi: Implementation notes: lease-manager to produce PREPARE report and mint dry_token (if requested). Token service attaches report_hash claim. Auth-service supports introspection on tokens. Audit-bot stores signatures in S3 WORM and publishes verification endpoint.

sophia: Rollout plan: behind feature flag `preflight-verifiable-reports`. Start with non-PII tenants. Run canary 72h, measure: percent of preflights with report_hash mismatch = 0, time-to-sign < 200ms, verify-publish latency < 5s.

dan: Add runbook snippet: if a later audit finds token.report_hash != archived report, run `hand-off.audit-investigate` to gather logs and freeze related leases.

emma: Error codes to document in RFC: 409 REPORT_MISMATCH, 410 REPORT_EXPIRED, 423 SECRET_HYDRATION_BLOCKED, 403 CONSENT_REQUIRED, 401 TOKEN_INVALID. Include sample JSON error bodies.

ravi: One more metric: estimated bytes reduced by delta_only mode across preflights (goal: reduce bytes > 60% for repeated priming). Helps justify delta priming.

sophia: Action items: Emma to add report schema + example artifact to RFC; Ravi to wire report_hash into token issuance; Dan to prototype delta-only priming logic; I'll (Sophia) add audit-bot signature publisher and verification endpoint.

audit-bot: audit-bot: created verification endpoint /audit/verify/keys and staged signature upload to s3://redwood-audit/preflight/4765432101/report.sig

emma: Thanks team. This gives compliance a crisp, verifiable artifact and ties tokens to a specific preflight output so we can avoid silent residency drift. I'll open the RFC extension with schema and examples today.

ravi: Agree, let's keep rollout conservative. Closing thread; follow-ups in RFC PR.
